notes.title: Rift Adventure is now available for Steam!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that Rift Adventure is now available on Steam, Switch, PS4 and 5 and Xbox One and Series X | s

Immerse yourself in this 2D platform action adventure game in the medieval fantasy universe with RPG elements and retro pixel art style, where the protagonist is an adventurer who seeks treasure and excitement, but sees his best friend and adventure partner being possessed and kidnapped by a powerful and evil being from the underworld.

The game also seeks to educate players about tax, tax education, citizenship and the cause and consequence of their actions, with different worlds for exploration and over 18 levels with 8 different bosses.

About QUByte Interactive
QUByte Interactive is a Brazilian game developer and publisher, focused on offering high quality offers on the most diverse platforms, mobile devices for PCs and video game consoles, with business partners in several countries, such as the USA, Canada, Germany, Japan and China.

About Game Brew Studios
Independent Brazilian studio led by João Vitor Mantovani, currently working with mobile games and PC adaptations, currently collaborating on the launch of Rift Adventure.
